text:
Alex Morales: Kicking off regional wave for v2.3.1 — adaptive warmup + OOM safeguard. Plan: canary in US, then EU, then APAC. Traffic slices pinned to v2.3.1 per wave. Keep CANARY_HOLD if any thermal/OOM signal.

DeployBot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-5690012345, region=us-west-2, slice=slice-1, start_traffic=5%, target_traffic=20% over 15m. Health checks: p95_latency < 300ms, err_rate < 0.5%, gpu_mem < 88%.

Marie Chen: Quick note — warm pool for EU is at 40% capacity after today's cleanup. I'll pre-warm +2 nodes for EU before we shift >10%.

Sam Patel: APAC thermal note: ap-southeast-1 had a thermal throttle alert yesterday night during a batch job. Recommend keeping APAC ramp conservative: 5% -> 10% -> 25% with 20m hold between steps.

Alex Morales: Ack. Decision rules: rollback immediate if gpu_mem > 92% for >2m OR p95 > 600ms OR error spikes >1.5% for two consecutive 5m windows. Rollback target: v2.2.9 pinned for that region.

DeployBot: Canary: us-west-2 @5% -> p95=112ms, err_rate=0.12%, gpu_mem=61% (ok). Advancing to 20%.

Rebecca Li: US trend looks clean. Observability: token-level cost didn't spike. Proceeding to start EU canary at +1m.

DeployBot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-5690012345-eu, region=eu-west-1, slice=slice-2, start_traffic=5%, target_traffic=20% over 20m.

Marie Chen: EU initial: p95=145ms, gpu_mem=70%. But warm pool auto-scaler only 2x capacity, adding +2 as planned.

John O'Neill: Operational safeguard: if any region shows memory fragmentation leading to OOMs, we trigger immediate drain and rollback. I put this as a manual FR on-call check: /oncall confirm before APAC start.

Alex Morales: Good. Embedding the rollback command here for quick use:
```
# rollback to v2.2.9 for region
redwoodctl rollout rollback --region eu-west-1 --version v2.2.9 --reason "canary OOM/latency"
```

DeployBot: EU canary health: p95=160ms, err_rate=0.5%, gpu_mem=88% (rising). Advancing paused at 20% due to mem climb. HOLD triggered.

Marie Chen: I'm seeing increased max_allocations in the EU model server logs — likely a transient cache pressure. Flushing model KV cache on the slice now.

Rebecca Li: Monitoring after flush. If gpu_mem doesn't drop to <80% in 3m, execute rollback command above.

DeployBot: EU gpu_mem after KV flush = 76% (3m). HOLD released. Proceeding to step to 50% with a 10m watch window.

Sam Patel: Noted APAC still on standby until EU stable and oncall confirms thermal window. I'll keep the extra cooling cushion: min_reserved_capacity=1.2x.

John O'Neill: APAC can start warmup at 05:30 UTC as discussed, with my manual go/no-go bump if we see system-level swap or dmesg OOM logs.

DeployBot: US canary completed: status=PASS, final_traffic=100% for slice-1, rolled to full traffic per policy.

Alex Morales: Final checklist before APAC: 1) EU stable for 20m at p95<300ms and gpu_mem<80% 2) Warm pool >=1.1x target 3) Oncall John gives green. If any fail, APAC remains pinned at v2.2.9 and we open a follow-up.

Marie Chen: EU has been stable for 22m. p95=138ms, gpu_mem=74%, err_rate=0.08%.

John O'Neill: I checked node logs, no thermal or OOM indicators. Green for APAC start at my side.

DeployBot: Starting APAC warmup job: job_id=canary-5690012345-apac, region=ap-southeast-1, start_traffic=5%, target_traffic=25% over 30m with 20m holdpoints. OOM safeguard enabled: if gpu_mem>90% or dmesg contains 'Out of memory' -> auto-drain + rollback.

Sam Patel: Watching APAC telemetry. If we see device-side memory fragmentation, we have plan B: switch to quantized variant q4_0 for slice-3 (reduces mem by ~30%).

DeployBot: APAC health @5% -> p95=210ms, gpu_mem=65%, err_rate=0.2%. Advancing to 10% now.

Rebecca Li: Note for release notes: v2.3.1 adds adaptive warmup and OOM safeguard flags. Call out the per-region ramp defaults and the quantized fallback option.

Alex Morales: Thanks team. After APAC passes the 25% watch window and we verify cost and latency, we'll schedule the rollout complete note and agenda for post-release eval. If anything degrades, follow the rollback command above and ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: APAC at target 25% after watch window. Status=PASS. Global rollout complete for v2.3.1.
